# Sample licenses & attribution

## Pitched instruments (piano, guitar-acoustic, guitar-electric, bass-electric, flute, xylophone, organ)

Samples from **tonejs-instruments** by Nicholaus P. Brosowsky
(https://github.com/nbrosowsky/tonejs-instruments, vendored via the
Makefully-Studios npm packages `tonejs-instrument-*-mp3`).

- Samples: **Creative Commons Attribution 3.0** (CC-BY 3.0)
  https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/
- Per upstream: "All the samples have been edited for consistency: trimming
  silence, on/off ramp, volume-matching, normalizing, noise removal, and some
  pitch-correction where necessary."
- Package code (not shipped here): MIT.

Only a pruned subset of the sample files is vendored; files are unmodified.

## Drum kit (vendor/samples/drumkit)

Samples vendored from **@teropa/drumkit** (code MIT). Sample sources per its
README, from freesound.org:

- DWSD — "Deep House Drum kit" (kick, snares, hi-hats):
  https://freesound.org/people/DWSD/packs/11575/ — **CC-BY**
- stomachache — "Analog Cymbal" (ride/crash):
  https://freesound.org/people/stomachache/sounds/140153/ — **CC0**
- Karman Lyne — "808 toms":
  https://freesound.org/people/Karman_Lyne/sounds/520168/ — **CC0**

## In-app attribution

The app displays the attribution line from `manifest.js` (`ATTRIBUTION`) in
the UI, satisfying the CC-BY visible-credit requirement.
